structure: Part 4, Notification hub (task list). Read hub.fit.spec.js in full (22 tests: hub feature 10, commodity totals 5, the Commodity details row 2, the Review and submit button 5) and mined all 22 trace zips its read names. The trace CLI could not open them (TraceVersionError: traces were written by Playwright 1.63.0, newer than tim's viewer), so each zip was read from its unzipped copy in this part's working folder (h01..h22, verified against the zips' file listings and mapped to spec lines through test.trace stacks): the browser actions and selectors from 1-trace.trace, the network log from 1-trace.network, and the server-rendered HTML of every page from resources/*.html. Trace short names used in refs: h01=34521 (newly entered statuses), h02=86460 (Notification tasklist heading), h03=66a0b (every task opens), h04=9fabe (arrival details before a commodity), h05=14eb3 (commodity details while nothing chosen), h06=9ae69 (identification row absent), h07=9c588 (identification row appears), h08=9340d (section 2 order), h09=f896d (only one hint), h10=6b3c3 (no back link, return to dashboard), h11=e7523 (Commodity details row own task), h12=94963 (Commodity details Complete), h13=192df (review with only origin), h14=9699e (button group), h15=8fdf3 (review once all sections complete), h16=fed70 (single species, no identifier), h17=7b55a (axe, origin only), h18=1daf7 (totals read 0), h19=b80df (number, label, caption), h20=5829f (govuk design tokens), h21=5585e (small screen), h22=d269d (axe with totals). One page is in scope: the hub, GET /live-animals/notifications/{reference}, h1 'Overview'. Top to bottom it holds a journey strip (Draft tag and reference), the 'Your commodities' totals (two app-commodity-total boxes), the 'Notification tasklist' h2 over six numbered h3 sections each with its own govuk-task-list, and a button group (Review and submit, Return to dashboard). States seen: newly entered (origin only; 10 rows, no Identification details, no Transit countries), commodity chosen without numbers, commodity numbers saved, arrival details saved with no commodity (Transit countries appears), every section but documents complete (12 rows). Conditional rows: Identification details (once a commodity carrying identifiers is chosen) and Transit countries (once arrival details are saved). The pages the rows open were followed only as far as their heading and where saving them leads back; their contents belong to other parts.
